decision.explanation: Both awards are directly supported by the provided sources. The Grand Cross of the National Order of Merit is explicitly mentioned in D1S13, where it is described as being conferred upon Robert H. Frank by the President of France. The Leontief Prize is also explicitly stated in D2S13 as having been awarded to Robert H. Frank in 2004. Both awards pertain to the same referent (Robert H. Frank) and the same relation (receiving an award), but they are distinct awards and thus both qualify as valid answers.
